description: Imports a BookingKoala time-logs export into the business's actual visit records, as the Schedule time-logs import does: pass the whole file's text as csvData. Rows match existing bookings by booking id and are idempotent on booking plus service date, so re-importing the same file writes nothing new. It records what happened (clock in/out, dwell, lunch, travel); it sends nothing. Answers the import report (rows written, skipped, errors). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: import_time_logs
title: Import a time-logs CSV
